children: Marshalls plc announces that Simon Bourne, Chief Executive Officer of the Company, has been appointed to the Board of Castings P.L.C. as a Non-Executive Director, with effect from Thursday, 5 November 2026.
This announcement is made pursuant to paragraph 6.4.9R of the UK Listing Rules.
